wiki.title: Cinthia Zermeño Moore
wiki.extract: Cinthia Zermeño Moore is an American politician. She has been a member of the Nevada Assembly since 2024. A member of the Democratic Party, she was elected in the 2024 Nevada Assembly election. She was born in Jalisco, Mexico. Her family moved to the Las Vegas Valley over 30 years ago. She was Coordinator of the Environmental Justice Coalition.
